scope: Source discovery and metric assessment for all 194 FLOW countries. Completed searches are distinct from verified metadata and imported, reconciled annual observations.

definitions.reporter: The country whose statistical authority reports the observation to the collector.
definitions.mirror: An observation reported by the other end of the migration corridor; it does not establish a complete national series for this country.
definitions.observationCount: Available source-specific country-pair-year rows, including numeric zero. Two source observations can describe the same route-year; these counts are not additive migration totals.
definitions.metadataReviewed: A primary-source page or indexed official document was inspected for source identity, metric and caveats. This is not an observation-level reconciliation.
definitions.candidate: A possible source requiring dataset, country, year, metric and quality verification before importing any values.
definitions.modelFallback: Official statistics leaves missing route-years unavailable. FLOW fills gaps only in the explicitly selected Best available comparison.

selectionPolicy.preferredMetric: Annual persons changing country of usual residence, previous residence for arrivals or next residence for departures; generally at least 12 months.
selectionPolicy.missingData: Missing/confidential/restricted is unavailable, never zero. A published numeric zero is retained.
selectionPolicy.mixedRange: A range using official and modelled observations must disclose the source coverage; do not label its whole sum as an observed official total.
selectionPolicy.mirrorConflicts: Do not add destination and origin reports for the same route-year. Prefer the destination report and retain conflicting observations and flags for inspection.
selectionPolicy.comparisonFallback: FLOW model only when Best available comparison is explicitly selected

eurostat_imm5prv.label: Immigration by age group, sex and country of previous residence
eurostat_imm5prv.metric: Annual international changes of usual residence, persons
caveats: Official statistics can include national estimation, imputation, provisional values and breaks; the source flags must remain visible.
A reporting country and a partner country are different roles; partner observations do not establish a complete national migration series.
Absent, confidential or restricted observations are unavailable, not zero. Regional aggregates are not allocated to country pairs.
COMPLET age definition is preferred; REACH is used only when the preferred all-age value is unavailable.

eurostat_emi3nxt.label: Emigration by age group, sex and country of next usual residence
eurostat_emi3nxt.metric: Annual international changes of usual residence, persons
caveats: Official statistics can include national estimation, imputation, provisional values and breaks; the source flags must remain visible.
A reporting country and a partner country are different roles; partner observations do not establish a complete national migration series.
Absent, confidential or restricted observations are unavailable, not zero. Regional aggregates are not allocated to country pairs.
COMPLET age definition is preferred; REACH is used only when the preferred all-age value is unavailable.

unsd_incoming_previous_residence.label: UNdata: incoming international migrants by previous country of usual residence and sex
caveats: Country-year reporting is incomplete and has not been downloaded and reconciled in this implementation.
The collection description covers reference years 2010 onward as available; this is not a statement that every country or every year has data.
Duration definitions, administrative methods, sex totals and duplicate revisions require observation-level review before import.
unsd_incoming_previous_residence.metadataEvidence: Official UNdata search-index description verified; direct page fetch timed out during review.
unsd_incoming_previous_residence.coverageObservationNote: The unfiltered UNdata web view listed 40 reporting countries or areas and 65,203 records, including aggregate, age/sex or other non-bilateral entries. Reporter-year and counterpart coverage have not been independently reconciled. The public CSV handler returned HTTP 404 in the session; no records have been imported.

undesa_flows_2015.label: International Migration Flows to and from Selected Countries: 2015 Revision
undesa_flows_2015.provider: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
undesa_flows_2015.metric: Historical national immigration/emigration series with heterogeneous definitions
caveats: The 45 reporting-country names are verified in the official documentation; this is membership, not an audit of every observation.
The historical release cannot supply the post-2020 Belarus displacement figures.
Country of citizenship, birth and previous/next residence are not interchangeable; a country-specific series must be reviewed before use as a residence flow.
undesa_flows_2015.metadataEvidence: Official documentation reporting-country list verified through its search-index text; direct document fetch returned HTTP 403.

oecd_international_migration.label: OECD International Migration Database
oecd_international_migration.provider: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
oecd_international_migration.metric: Annual foreign-population flows and asylum applications, stocks and nationality acquisitions
caveats: OECD foreign-population inflows by nationality are not bilateral movements by previous residence.
National definitions differ; for example, some series count residence permits, whereas others use population registers.
Neither OECD membership nor appearance as a nationality establishes country-year reporting coverage. Country-level data coverage has not been extracted here.

undesa_migrant_stock_2024.label: International Migrant Stock 2024
undesa_migrant_stock_2024.provider: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
undesa_migrant_stock_2024.metric: International migrant population living in a country at a reference date
caveats: Stocks for 233 countries and areas over 1990–2024 are not annual migration flows.
Differences between stocks include deaths, naturalisation, revisions and other changes; do not sum or treat stock differences as gross movements.

usa_dhs_lpr.label: Yearbook of Immigration Statistics 2024, lawful permanent residents
usa_dhs_lpr.provider: US Department of Homeland Security, Office of Homeland Security Statistics
usa_dhs_lpr.metric: Persons obtaining lawful permanent resident status during the fiscal year
caveats: Status grants include adjustments for people already living in the United States.
Permanent admissions exclude many temporary and unauthorised migrants and are not all changes of usual residence.
Fiscal years do not match calendar years; table 11 is grouped by last residence, while other tables use birth or other classifications.

usa_census_acs.label: American Community Survey geographical mobility and migration guidance
usa_census_acs.metric: Survey estimates of residence one year ago and current residence
caveats: The published migration-flow page primarily links domestic state/county/metro flows; it is not a ready-made complete world-to-US bilateral table.
A bilateral international extract would require detailed-table or microdata work, survey weights, uncertainty and geography verification.
ACS multi-year estimates are overlapping period estimates; they cannot be added as independent annual immigration totals.

can_statcan_components.label: Table 17-10-0014-01: international migration components, annual
can_statcan_components.metric: Estimates of international migration components by age and gender
caveats: Annual migration components are not a complete country-to-country previous-residence table.
Immigrants, emigrants, returning emigrants and non-permanent residents have different component definitions.

can_statcan_last_residence_historical.label: Immigrants to Canada by country of last permanent residence, historical table 17-10-0010
can_statcan_last_residence_historical.metric: Historical immigrant admissions by last permanent residence
caveats: This is a historical table with limited country/region categories, not verified complete modern bilateral coverage.
An immigrant-admission administrative definition may exclude temporary moves and include status changes.

can_ircc_permanent_residents.label: Permanent Residents – Monthly IRCC Updates
can_ircc_permanent_residents.metric: Permanent resident status admissions by country of citizenship and other characteristics
caveats: Country of citizenship is not previous country of residence.
Permanent resident admissions include people already living in Canada, and do not include every temporary migrant.
The portal marks some CSV resources rounded and not for calculations; resource-level rounding and suppression must be reviewed.

aus_abs_overseas_migration.label: Overseas Migration, 2023–24 financial year
aus_abs_overseas_migration.metric: Official overseas migration estimates using residence outcomes
caveats: The 12-month residence threshold is assessed within a 16-month period; revisions and provisional estimates are part of the official method.
The main country breakdown is country of birth, not necessarily previous residence.
A complete previous-residence country table and calendar-year compatibility must be verified before bilateral import; arrivals/departures travel events are a different series.

nzl_stats_migration.label: International migration: June 2024, country of last permanent residence data
nzl_stats_migration.metric: Estimated migrant arrivals using the 12/16-month residence-outcome rule
caveats: The release links a citizenship-by-visa-by-country-of-last-permanent-residence CSV; citizenship is not a substitute for last residence.
Not all last-residence responses are known. Provisional estimates are revised and the model training window changed in 2024.
Rolling-year totals overlap. Non-overlapping calendar periods, duplicate dimensions and final/provisional vintages must be reconciled before import.
An incoming last-residence table does not establish a complete outgoing next-residence series.

gbr_ons_long_term.label: Understanding international migration statistics
gbr_ons_long_term.provider: Office for National Statistics, United Kingdom
gbr_ons_long_term.metric: Official estimates of long-term international migration
caveats: Long-term migrants change usual residence for at least 12 months; administrative sources and estimation methods vary across populations and vintages.
Visa grants, nationality and country of birth are not previous/next residence flows.
Comparable UK observations are imported only where available in the archived Eurostat residence-flow tables; this methodology link is not a separate imported series.

isr_cbs_aliyah.label: Immigrants by selected last country of residence and first locality of residence in Israel, table 6
isr_cbs_aliyah.metric: Immigrants in the national immigration/aliyah statistical category
caveats: The national immigrant/aliyah category is not verified to include all international changes of usual residence.
Selected country rows do not establish complete worldwide coverage; release reference year and definitions require extraction before use.
Do not combine this category with broader migration estimates without labelling the difference.

pol_gus_permanent_migration.label: Main directions of emigration and immigration in 1966–2024: migration for permanent residence
caveats: Registration/deregistration for permanent residence is narrower than all people moving to live in Poland for at least one year.
Temporary residence, many work-related moves and some post-2020 Belarus migration are outside this permanent-registration measure.
Do not silently replace a harmonised long-term migration series with this narrower measure.

pol_udsc_administration.label: Migration statistics: permits, legal residence and protection
pol_udsc_administration.metric: Residence permits, documents and international-protection administrative statistics
caveats: Valid residence permits at a date are a stock of legal-status holders, not annual arrivals from Belarus.
Permits issued and visas issued are administrative events that can include renewals and people already resident.
These statistics are valuable contextual checks, but cannot be added to residence-flow counts or used to infer a previous-residence corridor.

col_migracion_movements.label: Flujos migratorios: administrative entries and exits
col_migracion_movements.metric: Recorded international trips at migration control points
caveats: The provider explicitly defines these flows as journeys, not distinct people: one traveller can make several entries/exits.
Trips include short visits and do not establish a change of usual residence.
Venezuelans intending to remain and residence/protection documents are separate metrics.

chl_sermig_permits.label: Open migration administrative data
chl_sermig_permits.metric: Temporary/permanent residence applications and decisions, and refugee procedures
caveats: The provider explicitly states the data count residence permits, not people.
Applications, grants, renewals and stocks of residents are different measures and must not be added as migration movements.

chl_ine_resident_stock.label: Estimated foreign usual-resident population, 2023 methodology
chl_ine_resident_stock.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas and Servicio Nacional de Migraciones, Chile
chl_ine_resident_stock.metric: Estimated foreign resident population at 31 December
caveats: The EPE series is a population stock; annual stock differences are not gross immigration.
Data integration and methodology changes affect comparisons between editions.

zaf_statssa_profile.label: Migration Profile Report for South Africa: A Country Profile, 2023
zaf_statssa_profile.metric: National migration profile combining multiple statistical and administrative sources
caveats: The existence of an official profile is verified; a complete annual bilateral previous/next-residence extract has not been verified.
Census migrant stocks, travel movements, legal permits and residence flows must remain separate.

jpn_isa_statistics.label: Immigration Services Agency statistics
jpn_isa_statistics.metric: Administrative entry/exit, residence examination and immigration procedures
caveats: The official statistics gateway is verified; a comparable annual all-person bilateral residence-flow table has not been verified.
Entry/exit events, residence statuses and foreign-resident stocks have different definitions.

unhcr_forced_displacement_flows.label: Forcibly displaced flow data
unhcr_forced_displacement_flows.provider: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
unhcr_forced_displacement_flows.metric: Estimated annual flows of forcibly displaced people by country of origin and asylum
caveats: Includes specific protection and displacement populations and is not a complete measure of all migrants.
Origin and country of asylum are not necessarily the immediately previous and next countries of residence; individuals may move onward, return, or seek asylum after an earlier move.
Do not substitute these counts for bilateral all-person residence flows or add them to those flows. Country-year coverage and revisions require verification before any import.

mex_inegi_census_2020.label: 2020 Population and Housing Census: conceptual framework
mex_inegi_census_2020.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
mex_inegi_census_2020.metric: Census questions on previous residence and household emigration during a five-year reference period
caveats: The census and five-year reference periods do not establish complete annual bilateral flows.
Survey coverage, household emigration and people absent from surveyed households need assessment before import.
Residence at a reference date is not automatically a count of every movement.

mex_inegi_enadid_2023.label: National Survey of Demographic Dynamics 2023
mex_inegi_enadid_2023.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
mex_inegi_enadid_2023.metric: Survey of international departures during the previous five years with intention to live, study or work abroad
caveats: Survey estimates are subject to sampling uncertainty and household coverage.
The five-year reference period and stated intentions do not directly equal annual usual-residence flows.
Country-specific tabulations, weights and uncertainty must be verified before import.

bra_ibge_census_2022.label: Brazil 2022 census: fertility and migration sample
bra_ibge_census_2022.provider: Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE)
bra_ibge_census_2022.metric: Census residents by place of birth, previous residence and residence five years before census
caveats: The 2022 census does not cover international emigration.
Census population and five-year residence measures are not complete annual bilateral migration flows.
Sample estimates and country-specific categories need reconciliation before import.

arg_indec_census_2022.label: Argentina 2022 census: international and internal migration
arg_indec_census_2022.provider: National Institute of Statistics and Censuses (INDEC)
arg_indec_census_2022.metric: Census population born abroad by country of birth and period of arrival
caveats: The census describes residents at the census date, not every arrival or departure.
Country of birth is not necessarily previous country of residence.
Arrival periods and census coverage require review before using as any flow measure.

afg_national_audit_2026.label: Afghanistan returnee and displacement statistics
afg_national_audit_2026.metric: Administrative returnee counts and internally displaced families over stated reporting periods
caveats: Returnees are a selected migration population; family and person counts and Afghan-calendar partial periods must not be mixed with annual gross all-person flows.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

alb_national_audit_2026.label: INSTAT migration and migrant integration
alb_national_audit_2026.metric: National immigration/emigration estimates alongside permit and asylum statistics
caveats: INSTAT describes proxy migration estimates from the labour-force migration module and population projections; a complete bilateral previous/next-residence extract was not established. Permit stocks are separate.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

dza-ons-rgph2008-ilo-metadata.label: ONS RGPH 2008 migration metadata reported to ILO
dza-ons-rgph2008-ilo-metadata.provider: Algerian Office National des Statistiques; nationally reported metadata published by ILO
dza-ons-rgph2008-ilo-metadata.metric: Census country of birth/citizenship and household members whose last departure abroad was within five years and who had not returned
dza-ons-rgph2008-ilo-metadata.geographicBasis: National census; household emigration and birthplace/citizenship are different concepts
caveats: Historical metadata from the ILO 2015–2016 source survey; not evidence of 2020–2024 annual coverage.
Census documentation explicitly says international migration characteristics were not disseminated because of underestimation.
Retrospective surviving-household departures exclude whole-household emigration and returnees; not gross annual migration flows.

and_national_audit_2026.label: Andorra population projections 2024–2036
and_national_audit_2026.metric: Population projections with explicit immigration and emigration assumptions
caveats: Projected migration assumptions are scenarios rather than observed annual flows and are not bilateral. Do not display projected 2024 values as actual 2024 observations.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

ago_national_audit_2026.label: Angola INE population projection migration methodology
ago_national_audit_2026.metric: Census five-year immigration reference and migration assumptions for population projections
caveats: The 2014 census reference counts arrivals over five years who stayed at least six months; it is not an annual 12-month residence-flow series.
Projection assumptions and long-stay visa application inputs must not be labelled observed annual bilateral immigration.
Metadata review only; no observations imported.

atg_national_audit_2026.label: Antigua and Barbuda 2001 census migration sections
atg_national_audit_2026.metric: Census birthplace, previous residence and household-reported permanent emigration
caveats: Historical census snapshot; migration questions exclude some study/medical/holiday departures and do not provide complete calendar-year gross flows. Later census publications are available separately.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

arm_national_audit_2026.label: ArmStatBank RA arrivals and departures
arm_national_audit_2026.provider: Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia
arm_national_audit_2026.metric: Annual national arrivals and departures estimates
caveats: The selected table exposes indicators and years, not counterpart countries. Its footnote says 2010–2011 recalculated using the 2011 census and from 2012 estimated using the Household Integrated Living Conditions Survey.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

aut_national_audit_2026.label: Statistics Austria international migration
aut_national_audit_2026.metric: Registered international changes of main residence
caveats: National series includes people registered for at least 90 consecutive days, not automatically the 12-month international usual-residence concept. Since 2002 based on Central Population Register registrations/deregistrations.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

aze_national_audit_2026.label: Azerbaijan demographic indicators: international migration
aze_national_audit_2026.provider: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
aze_national_audit_2026.metric: Arrivals and departures for permanent residence by country
caveats: Permanent-residence registrations have narrower administrative eligibility than all long-term residence changes. Separate border-arrival releases count travel and must not be substituted.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bhr_national_audit_2026.label: Bahrain Census 2020 population by nationality groups
bhr_national_audit_2026.provider: Information & eGovernment Authority, Bahrain Open Data Portal
bhr_national_audit_2026.metric: Census population by nationality group, governorate and sex
caveats: These are resident stocks by nationality group, not bilateral arrival/departure observations. Aggregated nationality groups cannot be allocated to missing country pairs.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bgd_national_audit_2026.label: Bangladesh census and international migrants publications
caveats: The official catalog lists international-migrant thematic material and 2022 census reports; exact country/year tabulation and migration reference period remain unverified. Labour-migration cost surveys are not all-person flow counts.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

brb_national_audit_2026.label: Barbados 2021 Population and Housing Census
brb_national_audit_2026.metric: Resident census characteristics and household-reported emigrants since 2010
caveats: Emigrant question covers people who left a surviving household since 2010 and remain abroad; it excludes returnees by construction. Census reference date and long enumeration period must be respected.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

blr-belstat-census2019-unece-paper.label: Belstat 2019 census migration characteristics: national paper hosted by UNECE
blr-belstat-census2019-unece-paper.provider: National Statistical Committee of the Republic of Belarus; UNECE archive
blr-belstat-census2019-unece-paper.metric: Census surviving residents by previous residence, country of arrival, arrival period and reason; migration intentions recorded separately
blr-belstat-census2019-unece-paper.geographicBasis: National 2019 census; country of previous residence/arrival distinct from birthplace, citizenship and intentions
caveats: The 2019 census predates the post-2020 exodus and cannot validate Belarus–Poland movements in 2020–2024.
Surviving-resident census arrival histories are not complete gross annual arrivals or departures.
The paper compares some 2009 five-year questions with broader 2019 residence histories; do not assume identical time windows.
Annual Belstat migration gateway exists, but its detailed bilateral tables and current registration definitions remain unverified in this review.

bel_national_audit_2026.label: Statbel population movement methodology
bel_national_audit_2026.metric: Annual registered international immigration and emigration components
caveats: Includes re-registrations, automatic deletions and changes between registers as well as moves. National registered-population rules must be reconciled with the target definition; do not sum immigrant-stock tables.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

blz_national_audit_2026.label: Migration Report Belize 2022 Census
blz_national_audit_2026.metric: Census immigrant/emigrant population, reasons and year of last move
caveats: Census survivors/residents and household-reported emigrants are not a complete annual register of gross moves. Year last came or left and country definitions need table-level review.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

ben_national_audit_2026.label: Benin 2024 gender booklet: migration from RGPH4
ben_national_audit_2026.provider: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie
caveats: Publication date is 2024 but underlying migration source is RGPH4, not annual observations for 2024. Separate internal commune changes from international moves.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

btn_national_audit_2026.label: Rural–Urban Migration and Urbanisation in Bhutan
btn_national_audit_2026.metric: Migration stocks and net-flow patterns from the 2017 census
caveats: Report explicitly says the census did not collect full migration histories; flows/stock diagrams are abridged approximations. Internal migration focus cannot stand in for annual international bilateral flows.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bol_national_audit_2026.label: Bolivia census international migration tables
bol_national_audit_2026.metric: International immigrants by country of birth in censuses 2012 and 2024
caveats: Birthplace is not previous residence. Census emigrant microdata are household reports about people still abroad and require separate handling; neither is an annual gross residence-flow series.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bih_national_audit_2026.label: BHAS migration statistics activity and release scope
bih_national_audit_2026.provider: Agency for Statistics of Bosnia and Herzegovina
bih_national_audit_2026.metric: Internal registered changes of residence published annually
caveats: The reviewed annual work report describes internal moves between Federation, Republika Srpska and Brčko. These must not be mistaken for international immigration/emigration. No national bilateral international table was verified.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bwa_national_audit_2026.label: Botswana Census 2022 Analytical Report Volume 3
caveats: The primary catalog verifies the census analytical report and publication date; exact migration-country variables, reference periods and bilateral tables still need detailed extraction. No claim of annual coverage.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

brn_national_audit_2026.label: Brunei Census 2021 demographic characteristics
brn_national_audit_2026.provider: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics
brn_national_audit_2026.metric: Census population by country of birth and resident status
caveats: Birthplace/resident-status stocks differ from previous/next residence flows. The separately listed persons-entering/exiting series is travel administration until residence criteria are established.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bgr_national_audit_2026.label: Bulgaria NSI migration definitions and data
bgr_national_audit_2026.metric: Calendar-year changes of usual residence/current address
caveats: NSI defines international movement as changing an address in Bulgaria for one abroad or vice versa. Tables by citizenship are separate from the needed country-of-previous/next-residence breakdown; national registration/permit scope needs reconciliation.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bfa_national_audit_2026.label: Burkina Faso RGPH 2019 migration material
bfa_national_audit_2026.provider: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie
caveats: Collection ran November–December 2019. Recent and five-year migration reference windows are not calendar-year flow series; the catalog states this version provides final reports rather than microdata.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

bdi-bcr-rgph2008-ihsn.label: Burundi RGPH 2008 national census archival metadata
bdi-bcr-rgph2008-ihsn.provider: Bureau Central de Recensement, Government of Burundi; IHSN catalog documented by World Bank
bdi-bcr-rgph2008-ihsn.metric: Household reports of departure abroad since October 1993 and return since August 2000, enumerated in 2008
bdi-bcr-rgph2008-ihsn.geographicBasis: National census; households and individuals; distinct departure/return reference windows
caveats: Historical census, not a 2020–2024 annual bilateral flow source.
Departures and returns have different multi-year reference windows; do not sum as comparable calendar-year observations.
Catalog establishes questionnaire scope and national authorship; detailed destination tables and publication completeness remain unverified.

khm_national_audit_2026.label: Cambodia General Population Census 2019
khm_national_audit_2026.metric: Census movement and migration by previous residence
caveats: Census report combines internal and international migration and records the surviving resident population. It is not an annual complete bilateral gross-flow series; distinguish provinces from foreign countries.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

cmr_national_audit_2026.label: Cameroon RGPH 2005 migration documentation
cmr_national_audit_2026.provider: BUCREP / Institut National de la Statistique Cameroun
caveats: Historical 2005 census material includes international migration but does not establish annual 2020–2024 gross flows. Country basis and reference periods require table-level inspection.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

cpv_national_audit_2026.label: Cabo Verde Censo 2021 Migrações
cpv_national_audit_2026.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estatística Cabo Verde
cpv_national_audit_2026.metric: Census migration and household-reported emigration over five preceding years
caveats: Reference window includes only half of 2016 and half of 2021. Such partial periods and household recall must not be presented as complete calendar-year flows.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

caf_national_audit_2026.label: Central African Republic RGPH 2003 migration and urbanisation report
caf_national_audit_2026.metric: Historical census migration and urbanisation analysis
caveats: Catalog confirms a June 2005 analytical report for the December 2003 census. Country definitions and tables need extraction; this is not current annual bilateral flow coverage.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

tcd_national_audit_2026.label: Chad RGPH2 2009 metadata
tcd_national_audit_2026.provider: Institut National de la Statistique, des Études Économiques et Démographiques
caveats: National census was enumerated in May–June 2009 and includes ordinary/collective households. Exact international-country flow definitions remain unverified; microdata conditions and inconsistent catalog reference-period fields require review.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

com_national_audit_2026.label: Comoros RGPH 2017 migration and urbanisation
com_national_audit_2026.provider: Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques et Démographiques
com_national_audit_2026.metric: Census lifetime and last migration, international migration context
caveats: Census does not record complete movement histories. Maore/Mayotte was not enumerated and source territorial classifications must be reconciled explicitly before any mapping.
Metadata review only; no observations imported or numeric totals independently reconciled.

cri_inec_census_2022_migration.label: INEC Census 2022 enumerator instructions
cri_inec_census_2022_migration.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (Costa Rica)
cri_inec_census_2022_migration.metric: Census questions on residence, foreign birth and last arrival to live in Costa Rica
caveats: The manual documents questions, not verified annual observations.
Arrival year among people still resident at census is not every gross migration.
Full PDF retrieval exceeded the web tool size limit; metadata checked in indexed primary-document excerpts.

hrv_dzs_migration_2024.label: Migration of Population of the Republic of Croatia, 2024
hrv_dzs_migration_2024.metric: Annual international immigration and emigration, including table by country of origin/destination and citizenship
caveats: Usual-residence changes use an actual or intended stay of at least one year.
2024 includes displaced people from Ukraine granted temporary protection.
National and Eurostat presentations may overlap; never add duplicate reports.

cub-onei-demographic-yearbook2024.label: ONEI Demographic Yearbook 2024: external net migration
cub-onei-demographic-yearbook2024.provider: Oficina Nacional de Estadística e Información (ONEI), Cuba
cub-onei-demographic-yearbook2024.metric: External net migration by sex, 1969–2024 (table 6.2); province-level immigration and emigration totals, 2020–2024 (table 6.2.1)
